en: Oh, kiddo. Perfect timing.

jp: 困ったお客様が来ていてねぇ・・
en: We've got a troublesome customer in...
A troublesome customer?
That's right. A troublesome customer.

jp: 質の悪い酔っぱらいだったら
いつものようにガツーンっと・・
en: What, if it's some nasty drunk, just give 'em the usual wallop and...

jp: そうじゃないから困ってるのさ
en: Well, that's the thing... It's not, which is the problem.
Where is Bale?!

jp: どこかで聞き覚えが・・・
en: That voice... I've heard it somewhere before...

jp: あんた達の知り合いかい？
さっきから、他のお客さんが
怯えるから困ってるんだよ
en: Friends of yours? He's been scaring my other customers, and I'm at my wits' end.
Cain, hey, THAT! Over there, is that--!?

jp: 大人しく質問に答えれば
手荒なマネはしない・・・
en: Where is Bale? Answer my questions quietly and I won't get rough...
I-I don't know! I don't know anything!!
...I see.

jp: 一向にベイル様の居場所が
わからないままですわ
en: This is troubling. We still have no idea where Bale-sama is.

jp: いればすぐに見つかるだろう
en: He is a conspicuous man. If he's here, he'll be found soon enough.
I suppose that's true.

jp: な、なんでこんなところにっ！？
en: Those two!? Wh-why are they here!?
Wawawah!
Y-you idiot! Shout like that and they'll spot us!
S-sorry...

jp: お二人で内緒話ですか？
en: My, my. Are you two sharing secrets?

jp: 貴方達ならベイル様の居場所を
en: Perfect timing. You two know where Bale-sama is, don't you?

jp: お前達は何をするつもりだよ？
en: And what do you plan to do once you know?

jp: そう警戒なさらないで下さい
貴方達に危害を加えるために
来たわけではありませんわ
en: Please don't be so wary. We haven't come to do you any harm.

jp: それじゃぁ、何をしにきたの？
en: Then what did you come for?

jp: ベイル様に直接お渡しするよう
テリオス様から承ったものが
en: I have something from Terios-sama to be handed directly to Bale-sama.

jp: ボクが代わりに渡しておくよ
en: Then I'll pass it along for you.

jp: いいえ、それは出来ません
ベイル様に直接お渡しするよう、
テリオス様から承っていますので
en: No, I cannot do that. Terios-sama instructed me to hand it to Bale-sama directly.

jp: とても、大切なものですから
en: It's very important, you see, so this one thing...
I see.

jp: 教えていただけますか？
en: Could you tell me where Bale-sama is?

jp: 本当にわからないんだ
en: Sorry. I really don't know.

jp: たぶん、ちょっと出かけている
だけだと思うけど・・・
en: He's probably just stepped out for a bit, I think...
I see.

jp: ボクが捜しに行ってあげるよ！
en: I know! I'll go look for him for you!
Could we really leave it to you?
Yeah, leave it to me.

jp: なんでもそんな簡単に
en: Hey, hey, Cain! Don't go agreeing to everything so easily!

jp: ボクが捜しに行ってる間
エクサルは二人をよろしくね
en: Exal, look after these two while I'm out searching, okay?

jp: 俺がこいつら面倒見るのかよ？！
en: Hey, hey, wait! I'M supposed to babysit them?!
I'm counting on you, Exal!!
Heeey, wait, Cain?!
Please don't trouble yourself over us.
...Easy for you to say.

jp: カインさんが戻られるまで
時間もありそうですし
en: ..Well then. It seems there is time before Cain-san returns.

jp: 私は一度ルビエル様の元に戻り
報告をすませておきますわ
en: I shall return to Rubiel-sama for now and finish my report.

jp: へぇ、あんたも大変そうだな
en: Huh, sounds like you've got it rough too.

jp: クレイスを置いていきますので
よろしくお願いしますね
en: Yes. In the meantime, I'll leave Kreis here, so please look after him.
Huh?
Well then...

jp: ちょ、ちょっと待てってば？！
en: W-wait, hold on?! What do you mean, "leave him"?!

jp: 本当に置いて行きやがった
en: ...... She really went and left him.

jp: ここで待っていればいいのか？
en: ...Am I to simply wait here?

jp: ああ、そうだけど・・・
en: Yeah, that's about it...

jp: しかし、こう間近で見ると
こいつってやっぱり・・・・
en: Still, seeing him up close like this, this guy really is....

jp: 私の顔に何かついているのか？
en: ...What is it? Is there something on my face?

jp: ちょっと込み入った話が
en: ...Hey. There's something kind of complicated I want to talk about. Got a minute?
I don't mind, but...

jp: それじゃあ、場所を移そうぜ
en: Then let's go somewhere else.

jp: ここで話せばいいだろう？
en: If you have something to say, you can say it here, can't you?

jp: 込み入った話って言っただろう？
en: I said it was complicated, didn't I?

jp: 大丈夫、カインのことだ
すぐには戻ってこないって！
en: Don't worry. It's Cain, he won't be back any time soon!

jp: 何の話をするつもりだ？
en: What on earth do you intend to talk about?
Don't be so on guard.

jp: ま、俺にとっては重要でも
あんたにとっては、どうでも
en: Well, it may matter to me, but to you it's nothing at all.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
